song.name: For Valen
song.plot: Album 3 opener. Anya carries Valen's memory into the last stand. After his fall in Symphony of Suffering, she makes his death her reason — she will not let the darkest world take what little light remains. Sets the resolve for the assault on Nyktoros.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: Anya, first person. Opens Dawn of Ravenspire by honoring Valen — his fall (Symphony of Suffering, Album 2 finale) becomes her resolve. Anchors: Valen, the Legion, Nythoria, the memory of the fallen, the vow to end the dark. Must not re-tell his death in detail (that was Album 2), must not claim a crown, no New Ravenspire founding (that is the vow/dawn beat, album 3 finale), no Rift re-crossing yet. Structure: Verse 1 → Chorus → Verse 2 → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus. Solemn but rising anthem. Suggested Suno direction: grief carried into fire — a lone voice over heavy strings and war drums, building to resolve.

section.name: Verse 1
section.reworked: They buried Valen in the fallen's soil, Beneath a sky that even stars forsook. I carry what he gave me from the fight, A vow that I will make the shadow break.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: For Valen, I will see the dawn, For Valen, I will hold the line. Until the Legion's rule is gone, His face will be this blade of mine.

section.name: Verse 2
section.reworked: I saw him fall upon the Shadow-Vale, A warrior's stand that owned the endless night. He left me not a promise, not a tale, But fire, and the fury of his might.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: For Valen, I will see the dawn, For Valen, I will hold the line. Until the Legion's rule is gone, His face will be this blade of mine.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: What would he have me do but fight? What would he have me be but free? I will not let the endless night Swallow the world he died to keep.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: For Valen, I will see the dawn, For Valen, I will hold the line. Until the Legion's rule is gone, His face will be this blade of mine.
